profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Healthcare & Clinical AI Platforms | Full Stack · End-to-End Delivery
profile.summary:
Who I Am
I’m a Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years building healthcare and clinical AI platforms. Currently shipping production multi-agent LLM features for the largest active community of medical experts, on a stack of Go, TypeScript/React, GPT-5, DynamoDB, and AWS EKS.

What I do
• Build features end-to-end across schema, API, frontend, infrastructure, and observability — no handoffs, no waiting on other teams
• Ship production AI: multi-agent LLM platforms, evidence-based answer drafting, proofread review, streaming UIs with planner/synthesizer architectures
• Scale products from 0 to N independently and own them through production incidents
• Mentor juniors, lead delivery on multi-month, multi-codebase projects, and set technical direction

How I work
Daily Claude Code driver. I’ve built a personal AI-assisted engineering workflow with ~20 custom commands, a 7-phase PR review skill that runs parallel sub-agents, and a full MCP tool ecosystem so my agents act on real systems instead of just reading code. This is how I get senior-engineer leverage on multi-repo work.

Stack I reach for: TypeScript, Go, Node.js, React, Next.js, NestJS, Python, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, DynamoDB, AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, Terraform.

Healthcare domains shipped in: pharma, hospitals, insurance, clinical trials, REMS programs, FHIR/EMR integration.

Off the keyboard: hiking and camping.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
At Mednet, the largest active community of medical experts. Building the AI layer of the platform alongside core platform engineering across the modern and legacy stacks.

What I have shipped:
🤖 Multi-Agent AI Platform — built a multi-agent LLM system in Go powering two production features: evidence-based expert-answer drafting and proofread review of physician-authored answers. Planner/synthesizer architecture on GPT-5, DynamoDB session caching, Server-Sent Events streaming with a “thinking step” preview, automatic citation of clinical guidelines, and per-conversation cost tracking for unit economics.

🔐 Doctor Onboarding V2 + Enterprise SSO — rewrote the doctor onboarding flow across four codebases with no regressions during cutover. Shipped SSO with Google, Microsoft, and Apple, including identity-mapping schema, OAuth provider chain, and automated Apple key rotation through AWS Secrets Manager. Migrated live traffic behind a LaunchDarkly flag with zero downtime.

🛡️ Shadow-Ban Moderation System — owned moderation for the platform’s core entities (questions, answers, comments) end-to-end across database, API, admin frontend, legacy services, and the email pipeline. Banned authors still see their own content; the community doesn’t.

⚙️ Platform engineering — speech-to-text dictation via AWS Transcribe Medical, GTM analytics pipeline with user-level identity attribution, Terraform/Kubernetes for new service rollouts, production debugging across CloudWatch, Sentry, and New Relic.

Stack: TypeScript/React, Node.js, Go, PHP/Yii, MySQL, DynamoDB, Redis, AWS EKS, Terraform.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
𝗡𝗼𝗱𝗲.𝗷𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗘𝘅𝗽𝗿𝗲𝘀𝘀.𝗷𝘀 (7+ 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀):
• Built RESTful APIs and GraphQL endpoints using Apollo Server.
• Proficient in Promises, Async/Await, and event-driven architecture.
• Integrated Socket.IO for real-time features like chat and notifications.
• Created middleware for logging, error handling, and preprocessing in Express.js.
• Developed Azure functions for FHIR data integration with EHR systems.
𝗡𝗼𝗱𝗲.𝗷𝘀 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗡𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗝𝗦 (6 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀):
• Developed RESTful APIs with JWT, OAuth2, and role-based access control in TypeScript
• Built microservices with Azure Service Bus for communication
• Developed with guards, interceptors, and pipelines
• Integrated TypeORM and Mongoose for database operations
• Performed unit testing with Jest
• Added Swagger documentation using @nestjs/swagger
𝗣𝘆𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗻 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗙𝗮𝘀𝘁𝗔𝗣𝗜(𝟱 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀):
• Developed high-performance REST APIs with FastAPI
• Used SQLAlchemy for Azure SQL Server, PostgreSQL and  PyMongo for MongoDB
• Built data validation for APIs with Pydantic
• Applied FastAPI dependency injection for modular code
• Developed ETL pipelines
• Wrote scripts for data processing and recurring tasks
𝗖𝗿𝗼𝘀𝘀-𝗖𝘂𝘁𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗖𝗼𝗻𝗰𝗲𝗿𝗻𝘀:
• Optimized APIs with Redis caching and MongoDB schema design
• Created Azure functions for background jobs and tasks
• Managed SQL Server/PostgreSQL for real-time reporting
• Proficient in Azure services: Web Apps, Function Apps, and CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps
𝗙𝗿𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗲𝗻𝗱
• Built SPAs with React, Context API, and Redux for state management
• Developed reusable components, hooks, and integrated APIs with Axios
• Improved performance with lazy loading and code-splitting
• Designed responsive UIs using Bootstrap, Tailwind CSS, and HTML/CSS
• Integrated real-time updates using Chart.js
𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁:
• Managed Agile projects via JIRA and conducted code reviews
• Led team across time zones and partnered with UX teams on Figma designs
